positions.name: MeridianGateDecision
positions.frame: how is the Meridian deployment gate decision framed, and what motivates it?
positions.why: src-1 issues the directive that signed release manifests are now required for Meridian deploys; src-2 supplies the motivating incident — two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter; src-3 restates the decision's key parameters (gate, scope, owner) as a declarative summary. All three cohere under the question of what the gate decision is and why it was made, with src-3 standing as a reformulation of the same decision alongside the directive and rationale that produced it.
